2.  Ensure the refund is tagged as "Conversion Loss" for accounting purposes.
3.  Update the ticket status to "Closed" upon successful refund processing.
4.  Notify the customer that the refund has been processed.

- Do not modify the original invoice; only process the refund.

args.subject: Refund Processed - Conversion Loss Reimbursement
args.body:
Dear Tailspin Ltd,

We have processed a refund of 175 to your account to reimburse the conversion loss from your invoice. This refund has been tagged as 'Conversion Loss' for accounting purposes.

Please allow a few business days for the funds to appear in your account. If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out.

Best regards,
Customer Support
